_comment: Known log lines for tools/dev/check_build.py. A line that contains one of these substrings is reported as KNOWN (not a failure). Any other ERROR line is NEW and fails the check. Add an entry only with a reason and a way out; do not add a pattern just to turn a check green.

known.reason: Editor-side system font lookup during export. Seen once in the first debug export of T4-B (t4b/debug/export.log:298), not reproduced in the tech-lead's re-export (TECH-REVIEW-L0a-T4B 3.2). Presumed editor side; the game itself looks fonts up by name at run time (SystemFont) and has the same root cause.
known.exit: T3-L3 (bundled fonts). L3 pass criteria: zero C:/WINDOWS/FONTS paths in export and run logs.
